scope: flat races only; 3-win/old 1600man through G1/OP/L in uploaded file; obstacle classes excluded

leakage_control.rule: for every target race, horse features use only starts strictly before that race

pre_race_structure_features.expected_escape_count: sum of each runner's shrinkage-smoothed prior escape probability
pre_race_structure_features.front_pressure_rate: mean prior probability of escape or front-running across entrants
pre_race_structure_features.minus3f_position: historical mean/quantiles of 上3F地点差 from prior starts only
pre_race_structure_features.pressure_index: equal-weight standardized combination: escape pressure + front pressure - historical 3F-position gap

rpcI_band_model_ablation.interpretation: style/pressure features show repeatable directional association with RPCI, but did not reliably improve probabilistic RPCI-band prediction beyond broader historical pace features on 2023-2025. Use them primarily as an explanatory race-structure axis, not as an aggressive probability adjustment.

style_realization_note.interpretation: predicting the exact number of runners classified as escape/front in the realized race is weak; the same pre-race tendencies are more useful for describing pace pressure than for naming the exact leader count.

recommended_app_labels.pressure_index_low: 先行圧低め / スロー側リスクあり
recommended_app_labels.pressure_index_high: 先行圧高め / 前傾方向
recommended_app_labels.usage: combine with RPCI probability distribution and conformal 90% range; do not convert pressure label alone into a betting signal
